thread:
Samir Patel: Heads up — Mariner (private VPC) deploy window confirmed for Tue Jun 15 02:00-03:30 UTC. Change: runtime v2 + private routing + small config tweak. I'll lead. Who's available for smoke + rollback?
Jess Liu: I can be primary for smoke checks. Will run the preflight checklist and smoke steps.
Owen Reed: I’ll own the traffic shift/canary script and watch the canary metrics. I need a quick +1 on the canary config PR before the window.
Tina Park: I’ll run the DB migration at T+10m (nonblocking). Migrations are additive; rollback plan: restore previous schema snapshot and toggle config flag.
Sara Gomez: I’ll monitor logs, tracing, and SLO dashboards. Posting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mariner-deploy (ops-only).
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: mariner-vpc-deploy (slot: 02:00-03:30 UTC). Reminder 30m before.
Samir Patel: @Jess, can you list the exact smoke steps here so ops can follow async? keep them short.
Jess Liu: Quick smoke steps: 1) hit /health on gateway, 2) sample gen with model v2 (10 tokens), 3) run routing check to private endpoint, 4) validate token billing metrics. Example curl:```
curl -sS -X POST https://mariner.private/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":10}'
```
Owen Reed: Canary config PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4123 — needs one more review (routing timeout tweak). I can merge at T-20m if someone approves.
Tina Park: DB snapshot taken and stored in s3://backups/mariner/pre-20260615.tar.gz — I’ll trigger migration only after canary shows stable 5m.
Sara Gomez: I'll create a temporary Grafana dashboard panel for canary latency and error rate, link posted in thread 15m before.
Samir Patel: Rollback runbook (short): 1) stop config rollout (ops script stop-rollout), 2) switch routing back to v1: `opsctl route set mariner --version v1`, 3) if schema issue, restore snapshot + run compatibility job. Keep DB restore as last resort.
Owen Reed: Small note — make sure KV cache invalidation is disabled during the switch or clients may get stale tokens. I’ll push the cache toggle to PR 4124.
Jess Liu: Can someone confirm that customer VPN break-glass is ready? we have the access key in 1password (mariner/team).
Sara Gomez: Confirmed, VPN break-glass credentials checked and warmed.
ops-bridge: Bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/ops/meet/Mariner-2684 (recording disabled).
Samir Patel: Timeline: T-60m final go/no-go check, T-30m merge canary config, T-10m start migration, T start shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Post-deploy smoke at T+30m.
Jess Liu: I'll post a short post-deploy checklist in the thread once we're green.
Owen Reed: @Samir I’ll stay through +45m for rollback readiness.
Tina Park: I’ll be oncall for DB until +60m.
Sara Gomez: I’ll keep dashboard notifications unmuted and relay any paging alerts to this thread.
Samir Patel: Thanks all. If you’re leaving earlier, drop a note here and hand off. Otherwise see you in the window — keep mobile on. :thumbsup:
Jess Liu: ack :white_check_mark:
Owen Reed: ack :rocket:
Tina Park: ack :lock:
Sara Gomez: ack :eyes:
